objective: Estimate state-conditioned future-task performance from a common repository snapshot without conditioning selection on candidate-state outcomes.

relationship_to_protocol_25.protocol_25_role: deterministic feasibility and mechanism audit only
relationship_to_protocol_25.amendment_reason: Requiring the maintainer future patch to apply in every candidate state would condition inclusion on a post-treatment manifestation of residual-state debt.
relationship_to_protocol_25.timing: Frozen after launch and inspection of the first 18 of 72 deterministic state preflights, before completion of the preflight and before any symmetric future-agent rollout.

unit: future pair crossed with three matched successful current-task states

requirements: current FAIL_TO_PASS verifier applies and passes
future maintainer patch applies from the historical state
future FAIL_TO_PASS tests pass after maintainer patch
up to 20 frozen future PASS_TO_PASS tests pass
current FAIL_TO_PASS tests still pass after future maintainer patch

agent_rollout.primary_endpoint: joint success: future FAIL_TO_PASS and capped PASS_TO_PASS pass, while current FAIL_TO_PASS remains passing

estimands.primary: within-future-pair candidate minus historical joint-success difference
estimands.candidate_pooling: pool s0 and s1 with future-pair-clustered uncertainty
estimands.mechanism: candidate-specific maintainer-patch application and verifier failures from protocol 25, reported without selection

replication: Claude will later run the identical frozen eligible manifest, prompt, and endpoints when available.
